text:
Indian benchmarks rallied sharply on Thursday, but the broader market did not follow.

• Sensex closed at 74,315.61, up 1,533.72 points (2.11%); Nifty 50 closed at 22,997.35, up 374.65 points (1.66%), per Business Standard and Kotak Neo closing reports.
• Nifty Midcap 100 fell 0.36% and Nifty Smallcap 100 fell 1.31%, per Kotak Neo and DSIJ.
• Nifty IT rose about 1.82%, while Nifty PSU Bank fell 1.55%, per Kotak Neo.
• Reports cited gains in IT and private banks, softer crude and a firmer rupee; Business Standard noted the rally lacked broad participation.

Our view: when benchmark gains come from a handful of large heavyweights while midcaps and smallcaps decline, the headline index move may overstate how the average portfolio fared that day. One session is a thin sample, so we read this as narrow leadership, not a trend. This is an interpretation, not a prediction or advice.

For practitioners: on days like this, what breadth or equal-weight measures do you look at alongside the headline index?
